definition: Administrative counts from state and Union Territory police submissions. Reporting, follow-up and revisions affect coverage.
Statistical estimates informed by available data. Keep them distinct from police counts, and preserve the reference year and uncertainty.
The time window after a crash matters. International systems often use 30 days; the report does not establish a verified definition for every Indian series.
All reported injuries, hospital admissions and clinically defined serious injuries are not interchangeable. The headline injury count includes reported injuries.
A population rate, vehicle rate and vehicle-kilometre rate answer different questions. Every rate needs a numerator, denominator, year and source.
Implementation measures activity; observed outcomes show change; causal evaluation asks what changed because of an intervention. A before-and-after trend alone cannot prove causation.
